scope: 通用广告/不公平行为 + 小家电（受管制商品 Safety Mark、电气安全）+ 隐私告知
review_policy: decision_level=rule_level 表示可在‘法条原文 + 页面原文’同时成立时给出规则级判断；substantiation 表示只能判‘需要证明’；human_review 表示需人工/律师复核。review_required=true 的条目必须人工复核后才能进入报告结论。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 供应商在消费交易中不得作出任何行为或陈述、也不得遗漏，以致消费者可能被合理误导或欺骗；判断看整体印象与合理性，不只看单个词。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面原文与上下文、广告投放时间、消费者可能理解的方式；若涉及事实性矛盾，附规格书/检测报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: CPFTA 主要是民事救济：消费者可起诉（s.6）或到小额索偿庭；CCCS 可向法院申请声明/禁令（s.9）。不公平行为本身不是刑事罪。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: It is an unfair practice for a supplier, in relation to a consumer transaction— ... (a) to do or say anything, or omit to do or say anything, if as a result a consumer might reasonably be deceived or misled;
rules.notes: 新加坡没有类似中国广告法的绝对化用语清单；‘best/no.1’是否违法取决于是否可证实、是否误导。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得作出虚假的声称（false claim）；认证、奖项、销量排名、功效、环保等声称必须有依据。
rules.evidence_needed: 证书/奖项主办方与年份、销量数据来源与统计口径、检测报告（方法、样本、实验室资质）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济（s.6/s.9）；不是刑事罚则。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (b) to make a false claim;

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务拥有其实际没有的赞助、批准、性能特征、配件、成分、质量、用途或好处。
rules.evidence_needed: 认证/批准文件、背书授权、性能测试报告、配件清单。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济；CCCS 可申请禁令。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 1. Representing that goods or services have sponsorship, approval, performance characteristics, accessories, ingredients, components, qualities, uses or benefits that they do not have.
rules.notes: Safety Mark 是新加坡受管制商品的强制标志；把 Safety Mark 与 SIRIM/CE 混写是常见问题。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品或服务具有其实际没有的标准、质量、等级、款式、型号、原产地、重量、体积、长度、容量或制造方法。
rules.evidence_needed: 规格书、材质证明、容量/重量实测、原产地证明、检测报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济（s.6/s.9）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4. Representing that goods or services are of a particular standard, quality, grade, style, model, origin, weight, volume, length, capacity or method of manufacture (as the case may be) if they are not.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得把非全新、已变质、被改装、翻新或回收的商品表示为新的或未使用过的。
rules.evidence_needed: 采购/入库记录、商品状态说明、翻新记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5. Representing that goods are new or unused if they are not or if they have deteriorated or been altered, reconditioned or reclaimed.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品/服务可得、因特定原因可得、以特定价格/数量/时间可得，而供应商知道或应知并非如此——除非该表示清楚说明了限制条件。
rules.evidence_needed: 库存记录、促销起止时间、价格适用条件；页面是否在 claim 旁清楚写明限制。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7. Representing that goods or services are available or are available for a particular reason, for a particular price, in particular quantities or at a particular time if the supplier knows or can reasonably be expected to know it is not so, unless the representation clearly states any limitation.
rules.notes: ‘While stocks last’ 如果没有说明数量或期间，可能不构成‘清楚说明限制’。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示存在价格利益或优势，而该利益或优势实际不存在（如虚构原价、虚假折扣）。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销前后实际售价记录、原价来源、同渠道比较价格（含日期）。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 9. Representing that a price benefit or advantage exists respecting goods or services where the price benefit or advantage does not exist.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得在供应商品/服务时提供赠品、奖品或其他免费物品，而供应商知道或应知该物品不会提供、或不会按承诺提供。
rules.evidence_needed: 赠品库存与发放记录、赠品条款、活动前后主商品价格。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 19. Offering gifts, prizes or other free items in connection with the supply of goods or services if the supplier knows or ought to know that the items will not be provided or provided as offered.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 不得表示商品/服务只在特定期间以折扣价供应，而供应商知道或应知该商品/服务在显著更长的期间仍会以该价格供应。
rules.evidence_needed: 促销起止记录、活动后售价与持续时间。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 20. Representing that goods or services are available at a discounted price for a stated period of time if the supplier knows or ought to know that the goods or services will continue to be so available for a substantially longer period.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Fair Trading) Act 2003 消费者保护（公平交易）法 2003
rules.requirement: 以社论、纪录片、科学报告等客观形式呈现、但实质是为销售商品/服务所作的表示，必须明确标注其为广告或促销。
rules.evidence_needed: 页面是否标注 ‘advertisement/promotion’、内容是否为付费/自营、发布位置与格式。
rules.penalty_or_note: 民事救济。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 16. Making a representation that appears in an objective form such as an editorial, documentary or scientific report when the representation is primarily made to sell goods or services, unless the representation states that it is an advertisement or a promotion.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act 1975 消费者保护（商品说明与安全要求）法 1975
rules.requirement: 在贸易或业务中，不得对商品施加虚假商品说明，也不得供应带有虚假商品说明的商品；‘虚假’包括因说明中包含或遗漏的内容而在实质方面虚假或可能误导。
rules.evidence_needed: 商品标签/详情页原文、规格书、供应商授权链、原产地证明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 s.4 属犯罪；无特定罚则时适用 s.15：最高 S$10,000 或监禁 2 年或两者兼施。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4. Subject to the provisions of this Act, any person who in the course of a trade or business— (a) applies a false trade description to any goods; or (b) supplies any goods to which a false trade description is applied, shall be guilty of an offence.
rules.notes: CPTDSRA 是刑事条款；CPFTA 是民事不公平行为条款，两者可并行。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Trade Descriptions and Safety Requirements) Act 1975 消费者保护（商品说明与安全要求）法 1975
rules.requirement: 若商品被表示符合某人规定/认可的标准、或暗示获得某人批准，而该人或该标准并不存在，则该表示被视为虚假商品说明。
rules.evidence_needed: 标准编号与发布机构、证书/批准文件、检测报告；核对标准是否真实存在并适用于该产品。
rules.penalty_or_note: 按 s.4 虚假商品说明处罚；s.15 最高 S$10,000/2 年。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5. For the purposes of this Part— ... (b) a false indication, or anything likely to be taken as an indication which would be false, that any goods comply with a standard specified or recognised by any person or implied by the approval of any person is deemed to be a false trade description, if there is no such person or no standard as specified, recognised or implied.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 受管制商品（controlled goods）在附表一指定日期后，未注册为 registered controlled goods、未符合安全要求并贴上 Safety Mark，不得在贸易/业务中供应或为供应而广告。
rules.evidence_needed: Safety Mark 照片与 8 位认证编号、CPSO 注册记录、 Registered Supplier 名称、证书/测试报告。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.4(1) 属 s.11(2) 罪行；罚则适用 CPTDSRA s.15：最高 S$10,000 或监禁 2 年或两者兼施。CPSO 可要求召回。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 4.—(1) No person shall, in the course of any trade or business, supply or advertise for the purpose of supply any controlled goods after the effective date specified in the First Schedule unless— (a) such controlled goods are registered controlled goods conforming to the safety requirements specified by the Safety Authority for those goods; and (b) such controlled goods have affixed to them the Safety Mark in accordance with Part III.
rules.notes: reg.4(1) 明文包含 ‘advertise for the purpose of supply’，与马来西亚 reg.97 类似。是否属于 controlled goods 要逐项对附表一（33 类）。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 进口商或制造商若打算在新加坡供应或为供应而广告受管制商品，必须向 Safety Authority 申请注册为 Registered Supplier，并注册其打算供应/广告的受管制商品。
rules.evidence_needed: Registered Supplier 注册号、CPSO 注册记录、进口商/制造商与卖家的关系。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.5(1) 最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施（reg.5(2)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 5.—(1) Any importer or manufacturer in Singapore who intends, in the course of any trade or business, to supply or advertise for supply any controlled goods in Singapore shall apply to the Safety Authority— (a) to be registered as a Registered Supplier; and (b) to register any controlled goods which the importer or manufacturer intends to supply or advertise for supply in Singapore.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 高风险/中风险受管制商品的注册申请，必须由 Registered Supplier 提交符合性证书（certificate of conformity）；低风险商品则提交供应商符合性声明（supplier’s declaration）。
rules.evidence_needed: CAB (Certification) 出具的 CoC、CAB (Testing) 或认可实验室的测试报告、对应型号与标准。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未按 reg.7 提交文件会影响注册；虚假文件可能触及其他法律。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 7.—(1) Subject to paragraph (5), an application for registration of any high-risk controlled goods or medium-risk controlled goods must be made by a Registered Supplier in such form as the Safety Authority may require, and must be accompanied by— (a) a certificate of conformity in respect of the controlled goods;
rules.notes: 风险等级由 Safety Authority 在官网分类；同一品类不同型号可能不同。

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 只有 Registered Supplier 才能在其注册且注册未被暂停/撤销的受管制商品上贴 Safety Mark，并须按 reg.14 的方式张贴。
rules.evidence_needed: Safety Mark 的 8 位认证编号、注册记录、贴标位置与形式是否符合 CPSO 指引。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 reg.13(1) 最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施（reg.13(4)）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 13.—(1) Subject to paragraph (2), no person shall affix the Safety Mark on any goods unless— (a) he is a Registered Supplier; ... (b) he affixes the Safety Mark on controlled goods registered by him with the Safety Authority, and the registration of such controlled goods is not deemed to be suspended or withdrawn under regulation 24; and (c) he affixes the Safety Mark in accordance with regulation 14.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 供应未注册/未贴 Safety Mark 的受管制商品，CPSO 可要求召回并向用户告知潜在危险；不执行召回属犯罪，最高 S$2,000 或监禁 12 个月或两者兼施。
rules.evidence_needed: CPSO 召回通知、召回执行记录、用户告知记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 不执行召回：S$2,000 / 12 个月（上限）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) Any person who fails or neglects to effect a recall of the controlled goods required by the Safety Authority under paragraph (2)(a) shall be guilty of an offence and shall be liable on conviction to a fine not exceeding $2,000 or to imprisonment for a term not exceeding 12 months or to both.

rules.law_name: Consumer Protection (Safety Requirements) Regulations (Cap. 53, Rg 1) 消费者保护（安全要求）条例
rules.requirement: 附表一列明 33 类受管制商品，包括液体加热器具（电水壶、airpot、热水机，容量≤10L）、厨房机器（搅拌机/绞肉机）、电饭煲等；这些品类适用 reg.4/5/7/13。
rules.evidence_needed: 产品品类与附表一逐项比对、额定电压 ≤250 Vac、容量等参数。
rules.penalty_or_note: 适用 reg.4 的罚则（最高 S$10,000/2 年）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: kettles, airpots and hot water dispensers, which are electrical appliances intended for household use to heat liquids for consumption that have a rated capacity not exceeding 10 litres, with rated voltage of not more than 250 Vac.
rules.notes: 附表一还包含电熨斗、微波炉、风扇、吸尘器、洗衣机等；完整清单需按最新版本核对。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须在收集个人数据之前（或在使用/披露新目的之前）告知个人收集、使用或披露的目的；并应个人要求提供能回答相关问题的业务联系人信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私通知/收集时的告知、目的说明、业务联系人、第三方披露说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: PDPA 主要通过专员指示与财务罚款执行：最高 S$1,000,000 或年营业额 10%（s.48J）；另有私人诉讼（s.48O）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 20.—(1) For the purposes of sections 14(1)(a) and 18(b), an organisation must inform the individual of— ... (a) the purposes for the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data (as the case may be) on or before collecting the personal data; (b) any other purpose of the use or disclosure of the personal data of which the individual has not been informed under paragraph (a), before the use or disclosure of the personal data for that purpose; and (c) on request by the individual, the business contact information of a person who is able to answer on behalf of the organisation the individual’s questions about the collection, use or disclosure of the personal data.
rules.notes: 新加坡法没有一条叫 ‘privacy policy’ 的强制条文；义务是收集前的目的告知。把‘没有隐私政策’直接判违法是过度推断。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须指定一名或多名负责人确保遵守 PDPA，并向公众提供至少一名被指定/授权人员的业务联系信息。
rules.evidence_needed: DPO 姓名/职务/邮箱/电话是否在隐私页面或联系页面公开、内部任命记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未遵守可能构成违反 PDPA；专员可发出指示并施加财务罚款（s.48J）。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: (3) An organisation must designate one or more individuals to be responsible for ensuring that the organisation complies with this Act. ... (5) An organisation must make available to the public the business contact information of at least one of the individuals designated under subsection (3) or delegated under subsection (4).

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织不得在未取得个人同意（或法定例外）的情况下收集、使用或披露个人数据；同意必须是自愿、知情且针对特定目的。
rules.evidence_needed: 同意机制截图（勾选框/双重 opt-in）、同意记录、退出机制、收集目的说明。
rules.penalty_or_note: 违反 Part 4 可被财务罚款（s.48J），最高 S$1,000,000 或年营业额 10%。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 13. An organisation must not, on or after 2 July 2014, collect, use or disclose personal data about an individual unless— (a) the individual gives, or is deemed to have given, his or her consent under this Act to the collection, use or disclosure, as the case may be; or (b) the collection, use or disclosure (as the case may be) without the individual’s consent is required or authorised under this Act or any other written law.
rules.notes: ‘By signing up you agree’ 是否构成有效同意取决于告知是否充分、是否有选择；语境判断。

rules.law_name: Personal Data Protection Act 2012 个人数据保护法 2012
rules.requirement: 组织必须制定并实施遵守 PDPA 所需的政策与做法，建立接收和回应投诉的流程，并在被要求时提供政策与投诉流程的信息。
rules.evidence_needed: 隐私/数据保护政策、投诉渠道、政策更新记录、员工告知记录。
rules.penalty_or_note: 未遵守可被专员指示/财务罚款。
rules.verbatim_excerpt: 12. An organisation must— (a) develop and implement policies and practices that are necessary for the organisation to meet the obligations of the organisation under this Act; ... (b) develop a process to receive and respond to complaints that may arise with respect to the application of this Act; ... (d) make information available on request about— (i) the policies and practices mentioned in paragraph (a); and (ii) the complaint process mentioned in paragraph (b).
